seo.title: Contact: Phone Numbers & WhatsApp | Aakash Eye Hospital
seo.description: Phone numbers, WhatsApp and directions for every Aakash Eye Hospital, from Visnagar and Himmatnagar to Ahmedabad and Bharuch, plus the emergency helpline.

label: Contact
title: The right desk,
lede: Six hospitals across Gujarat, and each one answers its own phone. Choose yours and every way in is one tap away.

desk.pickHint: Your choice also sets the number at the top of every page.
desk.whatsappMessage: Hello Aakash Eye Hospital, I would like to reach the {branch} hospital.

directory.label: Every desk
directory.title: Every number,
directory.lede: The OPD line books visits and answers questions. The operation and LASIK desks reach the surgical team directly.
directory.emergencyNote: Sudden loss of sight, an injury or a chemical splash: call this line first, from any hospital's area.
directory.hoursNote: For {branch}, the hospital chosen above. Each hospital keeps its own hours.
